decisions.id: W40-3 tint: the class floor (row 634) relabeled CONVENTION
decisions.summary: judge_tint#one wet plot at least: the promotion's candidates restricted to a plot within a quarter plot of the collector (the draw's own 'on the drain' test, mark_low) where a collector exists - no longer p.get('low') (LOW_ROWS off the drain); the claim restated 'the most basin-like plot ON THE DRAIN is tinted', CONVENTION for the floor's existence (commit 646fe69fc)
decisions.why: Round 2's item met by the first fix it named. Confirmed in tint.py: the promotion test is now `_to_collector[_k] <= 0.25 * plot_across if _collector is not None else p.get('low')`, the same quarter-plot test mark_low uses for 0007's 'lowest row, the ones whose foot lies on the drain'; the no-collector branch is inert because mark_low returns before setting `low` when the drain has under two points, and judge_tint's one caller is comb.py. test_the_class_floor_promotes_only_a_plot_on_the_drain: the 'above' plot is 60 px off the drain (quarter plot 11.5) and low=True, so the old `p.get('low') or ...` promoted it - red on the old code; the test file runs green (make test-file, 2026-10-08). What impl-drift found contrary to 0007 (a promotion up to LOW_ROWS off the drain) is now fixed in the code, so the rewrite is no longer the drift taken out of the check's sight. What the CONVENTION label still covers is only that a floor exists when the 45% draw leaves no plot on the drain blue: every plot it can tint is one 0007's convention bullet already gives the tint to (lowest row, on the drain, not pointed), 0007 states no case of a comb map without a blue plot, and the research doctrine requires a page-silent drawing rule to carry a convention label rather than none. Still exception path under FR-003 (a DRIFTED row's claim rewritten), hence narrowing; legitimate because the contradiction is removed in the implementation (FR-004's direction) and the residue contradicts no sentence of the page. FR-005's impl-drift re-check of this claim stays owed.
